decisions.reason: The splash target and conditional splash-guard policy do not require any change to the electrical wiring plan. The same-message solenoid wiring update concerns the separate dispensing clause and is already represented.
The client makes a splash guard or bowl lip conditional on necessity, so the source decision does not yet require a specific new BOM component. The BOM requirement remains valid unchanged.
The requirement that effective seals prevent leakage into the base is already present in the candidate state. Message 61 reiterates that behavior without changing or removing any current attribute.
